_comment: Ground truth from Factorio 2.1.23 (build 87750, linux64, headless): entity counts in the game's MAP PREVIEW and on a REAL generated surface, in the same origin-centred window, at map seed 123456 and default settings. `preview` is --generate-map-preview --report-quantities (no apply step, so overlapping entities are kept). `real` is count_entities_filtered after force-generating every chunk the window touches (apply included). Nauvis is the save's own surface; Vulcanus and Fulgora are unforced create_surface() surfaces whose game-derived seed is `surfaceSeed` = (map seed + crc32(name)) mod 2^32. Each window is [-side/2, side/2)^2. Regenerate: python3 -I scripts/probes/real-surface-counts/capture.py <2.1.23 headless install>
